concepts.gloss_en: The mochin (intellect/mentalities) of the Land of Israel — the supernal intellect associated with Eretz Yisrael, aspect of no'am

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are in the same teaching (LM 2:71) and refer to the identical concept — the mochin of Eretz Yisrael. The only difference is plene vs. defective spelling of מוחין/מחין, which is orthographic variation of the same word, not a homograph. Safe to merge.
